tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i gsung rgyun no/ /mdo rgyud mang thos gdengs can nor bu'i gtsug/srid gsum snying gi mun sel klu sgrub srol/ /zab da
༄༅/ /tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i gsung rgyun no/ /mdo rgyud mang thos gdengs can nor bu'i gtsug/srid gsum snying gi mun sel klu sgrub srol/ /zab da

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i gsung rgyun no// mdo rgyud mang thos gdengs can nor bu'i gtsug /srid gsum snying gi mun sel klu sgrub srol/ /zab don rgya mtsho'i bcud la rol rtsed mkhan/ /snying nas 'dud do 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol/ /zhes mchod par brjod nas 'dir tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i skabs su mtha' dpyad pa la gsum ste/ khas len pa po sems tsam pa'i rnam gzhag khas blang bya sems tsam pa'i grub mtha'i rnam gzhag skabs su babs pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag dngos so/ /dang po la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' smra ba bzhi po gang rung yin pa gang zhig phyi don med par khas len pa'i cha nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' smra ba gsum par bzhag pa de sems tsam pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems tsam pa/ rnal 'byor spyod pa ba/ /rnam rig pa/ mngon pa smra ba po dang bzhi don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba dang / grub mtha'i sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la sems tsam rnam bden pa dang / sems tsam rnam rdzun pa gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sems tsam pa gang zhig phyi rol don snang gi dbang shes la phyi rol don du snang ba bden grub tu khas len pa'i sems tsam pa de sems tsam rnam bden pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa de la dbye na/ gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam pa/ sgo nga phyed tshal ba/ sna tshogs gnyis med pa'i sems tsam rnam bden pa dang gsum yod pa'i dang po'i mtshan gzhi ni/ khra 'dzin dbang shes la khra bo sna tshogs pa snang ba'i tshe yul gzung bya'i grangs dang mnyam par 'dzin byed kyi shes pa yang rdzas tha dad par khas len pa'i sems tsam pa lta bu la 'jog gnyis pa ni/ khra 'dzin dbang shes la de ltar snang ba'i tshe gzung bya thams cad kyang rdzas gcig tu bden par grub pa dang 'dzin byed thams cad kyang gcig tu bden par grub par khas len zhing /

gzung bya dang 'dzin byed kyi shes pa gnyis rdzas gzhan du khas len pa'i sems tsam pa lta bu la 'jog gsum pa ni de ltar snang ba'i tshe gzung bya'i rnam pa dang 'dzin byed kyi shes pa gnyis rdzas gcig tu khas len pa'i sems tsam pa lta bu la 'jog gnyis pa sems tsam rnam rdzun pa la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sems tsam pa gang zhig phyi rol don snang gi dbang shes la phyi rol don du snang ba bden med sgro btags su khas len pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ dri bcas rnam rdzun pa dang dri med rnam rdzun pa gnyis yod/ dang po ni sangs rgyas kyi sa na gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi dri ma yod par 'dod pa yin la/ gnyis pa ni de'i sa na gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi dri ma med par bzhed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa grub mtha'i sgo nas dbye na/ lung gi rjes 'brang gi sems tsam pa dang / rigs pa'i rjes 'brang gi sems tsam gnyis yod pa'i dang po ni mngon pa gong 'og nas bshad pa'i sems tsam pa'i grub mtha' khas len pa'i sems tsam pa lta bu la 'jog gnyis pa ni/ tshad ma mdo/ rnam 'grel/ rigs gter sogs nas bshad pa'i sems tsam pa'i grub mtha' khas len pa'i sems tsam pa lta bu la 'jog gnyis pa khas blang bya sems tsam pa'i grub mtha'i rnam gzhag 'chad pa la bzhi ste/ sems tsam pa'i bshad bya'i bka' ngos bzung ba/ dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos ngos bzung ba/ bstan bcos des bka'i dgongs pa 'grel tshul bshad pa/ de ltar bkral ba'i sems tsam pa'i grub mtha' dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor/ bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor/ tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor dang gsum po de sems tsam pa'i bshad bya'i bka' yin zhing / khyad par kha cig sems tsam pa'i bshad bya'i bka' bzhi zhes zer ba ni/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel/ rgyan stug po bkod pa/ mdo sde sa bcu pa/

mdo lang kar gshegs pa dang bzhi po de la 'dzin pa yin te/ sems tsam pa rnams kyis mdo de bzhi nges don gyi bka' yin no zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa'i phyir ro// //gnyis pa dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos ngos gzung ba la gnyis te/ lung gi rjes 'brang gi bstan bcos ngos gzung ba dang / rigs pa'i rjes 'brang gi bstan bcos ngos gzung ba gnyis/ dang po la/ byams pa dang 'brel pa'i chos sde nyi shu zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nyi shu yod de/ rje btsun byams pas mdzad pa'i byams chos phyi ma bzhi/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i sa sde lnga/ sdom rnam pa gnyis/ thogs med 'grel chen dang brgyad/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i pra ka ra na sde brgyad dang nyi shu po de la 'jog go /nyi shu po de yang so sor ngos gzung na/ byams chos phyi ma bzhi ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan ma gtogs pa'i theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma/ mdo sde rgyan/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed/ chos nyid rnam 'byed dang bzhi po de yin/ sa sde lnga ni/ sa'i gzhi bsdu ba dang / sa'i dngos gzhi bsdu ba/ rnam grangs bsdu ba/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo bsdu ba/ rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba dang lnga po de yin zhing / sdom rnam pa gnyis ni/ theg pa thun mong ba'i sdoms mngon pa kun las btus dang / theg chen thun mong min pa'i sdoms theg bsdus gnyis po yin no/ /pra ka ra na sde brgyad ces pa ni/ sems tsam pa'i rtsa ba'i grub mtha' ston pa la sum bcu pa'i rab tu byed pa/ de'i sgrub byed ston pa la nyi shu pa'i rab tu byed pa/ de gnyis kyi skabs su snang ba thams cad sems tsam yin no zhes bstan pa la/ snang ba thams cad sems tsam yin na/ nyan bshad kyi rnam gzhag dang / las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag dang / phung po lnga'i rnam gzhag rnams mi 'thad par thal/ snang ba thams cad sems tsam yin pa'i phyir zer na/ de'i lan rim bzhin ston pa la/ rnam bshad rig pa/

las grub pa/ phung po lnga'i rab byed rnams gsungs shing / bstan bcos de lnga ni rang dbang du brtsams pa yin la/ gzhan dbang du brtsams pa gsum ni/ snang ba thams cad sems tsam yin na/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang / rang don pha rol phyin pa drug dang / gzhan don bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i rnam gzhag dang / mtshan nyid gsum gyi rnam gzhag rnams mi 'thad par thal lo zhe na/ de rnams kyi lan rim bzhin ston pa la/ rten 'brel mdo 'grel/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel pa/ 'byed rnam gnyis kyi 'grel pa rnams gsungs so/ /nyi shu po der ma 'dus pa yang brgyad stong 'grel chen la sogs pa yod do/ /gnyis pa rigs pa'i rjes 'brang gi sems tsam pa'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos ni/ tshad ma mdo'i sems tsam pa'i gzhung rnams dang / tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi tshad 'bras gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i rang gzhung rnams dang / mngon sum stod kyi/ de phyir gnyis stong gang yin pa/ /zhes sogs kyi gzhung rnams la 'jog go /gsum pa bka'i dgongs pa 'grel tshul 'chad pa la/ sems tsam pa'i bstan bcos de rnams kyis bka' 'khor lo rim pa gsum po de'i dgongs pa 'grel pa'i tshul yod de/ bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor/ bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor gnyis po de drang don gyi mdor dgongs pa 'grel/ bka' tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor de nges don gyi mdor dgongs pa 'grel ba'i phyir/ dang po de yin te/ bka' dang por phyi rol gyi don bden grub tu bstan pa de yang dgongs gzhi dgos pa dngos la gnod byed gsum gyi sgo nas drang don du 'grel/ bka' bar par chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu zhes bden med du bstan pa de yang dgongs gzhi dgos pa dngos la gnod byed gsum gyi sgo nas drang don du 'grel bar byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ bka' dang por phyi don bden grub tu bstan pa la dgongs gzhi yod de/

rang sde bye mdo gnyis dang / byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams la phyi rol don snang gi dbang shes sna tshogs pa gcig skye ba la dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar bstan pa'i dgos pa yod de/ rang sde theg dman gyi gang zag rnams theg chen gyi chos la kha drang bar bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ dngos la gnod byed yod de/ phyi don bden par grub pa la gcig du bral gyi rigs pas gnod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bka' bar par chos thams cad bden med du bstan pa'i dgongs gzhi yod de/ kun btags la rang gi mtshan nyid kyi ngo bo nyid med pa/ gzhan dbang la rang gi skye ba'i ngo bo nyid med pa/ yongs grub la don dam pa'i ngo bo nyid med pa ste ngo bo nyid med pa gsum po de la dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang sum cu pa las/ ngo bo nyid ni rnam gsum gyi/ /ngo bo nyid med rnam gsum la/ /dgongs nas chos rnams thams cad ni/ /ngo bo nyid med bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa de ltar bkral ba'i sems tsam pa'i grub mtha'i rnam gzhag dngos bshad pa la/ gzhi'i rnam gzhag lam gyi rnam gzhag 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag dang gsum/ dang po ni/ chos lnga dang ni rang bzhin gsum/ /rnam par shes pa brgyad nyid dang / /bden med gnyis kyi nang du ni/ /theg chen mtha' dag 'dir zad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos lnga'i rnam gzhag rang bzhin gsum gyi rnam gzhag bden pa gnyis kyi rnam gzhag bdag med gnyis kyi rnam gzhag rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa dang lnga/ dang po lnga ni/ rgyu mtshan dang ming dang / rnam par rtog pa dang / de bzhin nyid dang / yang dag pa'i ye shes dang lnga po de la 'jog la/ dang po'i mtshan gzhi ni/ bum pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni bum pa zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ khams gsum gyis bsdus pa'i yang dag pa min pa'i kun rtog lta bu la 'jog bzhi pa ni/ chos nyid lta bu/ lnga pa ni/

de bzhin nyid yul du byed pa'i gnyis med kyi ye shes lta bu la 'jog cing / de yang dang po gsum po de bsdus na gzhan dbang du 'dus pa yin te/ rgyu mtshan dang / ming dang / rnam par rtog pa dang gsum po gang rung yin na gzhan dbang yin dgos pa'i phyir/ /de skad du yang dbus mtha' las/ rgyu dang rnam par rtog pa dang / /ming ni rnam pa gsum du 'du/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de lnga'i nang tshan gyi de bzhin nyid dang yang dag pa'i ye shes gnyis po de yongs grub tu 'dus te/ de nyid las/ yang dag ye shes rab kho na/ /gcig po kho nas bsdus pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang dngos btags phye na/ yang dag pa'i ye shes yin na yongs grub min pas khyab ste/ de yin na gzhan dbang yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rang bzhin gsum gyi rnam gzhag 'chad pa la gsum ste/ kun brtags gzhan dbang / yongs grub bshad pa'o/ /dang po kun brtags la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba/ dngos btags dpyad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ gnas lugs la ma grub bzhin du rtog pas sgro btags pa'i chos de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ kun brtags dang / kun rdzob bden pa don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ rnam grangs pa'i kun brtags dang / mtshan nyid yongs su chad pa'i kun brtags gnyis yod pa'i dang po dang kun brtags don gcig gnyis pa ni ri bong rwa lta bu dang mo gsham gyi bu lta bu med pa mtha' dag la 'jog bzhi pa dngos btags dpyad pa ni/ mtshan nyid yongs su chad pa'i kun brtags yin na/ kun brtags ma yin pas khyab bo/ /gnyis pa gzhan dbang la mtshan nyid sogs gsum las mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi rgyu rkyen gzhan gyi dbang las skyes pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin/ khyab mnyam pa ni/ gzhan dbang dang dngos po don gcig de la dbye na dag pa gzhan dbang dang / ma dag pa gzhan dbang gnyis yod/ dang po dang zag med kyi dngos po don gcig de la dbye na bem shes ldan min 'du byed gsum yod pa'i mtshan gzhi rim bzhin/

sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mig dbang dang / rnam mkhyen dang / sangs 'phags rnams la 'jog gnyis pa ma dag gzhan dbang dang zag bcas don gcig de la dbye na yang bem shes ldan min 'du byed gsum yod do/ /gsum pa yongs grub la mtshan nyid sogs gsum las/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ gnas lugs la grub pa'i de bzhin nyid de yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa khyab mnyam pa la/ yongs grub/ chos nyid/ chos dbyings/ de bzhin nyid/ don dam pa'i dbyings/ don dam pa'i mtha'/ stong pa nyid/ smon pa med pa'i mtha' rnams don gcig ste/ stong pa nyid ni mdor bsdu na/ /de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /mtshan ma med dang don dam dang / /chos kyi dbyings rnams rnam grangs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa de la dbye na/ 'gyur med yongs grub dang / phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub gnyis yod de/ 'gyur med phyin ci ma log dang / /yongs su grub pa rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rnam shes tshogs brgyad ni/ 'jug shes drug nyon yid/ kun gzhi rnam shes dang brgyad po de yin zhing de rnams ni zur du 'chad/ bzhi pa bden pa gnyis kyi rnam bzhag la/ mtshan nyid sogs yod pa las/ dang po ni/ don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs shes tshad mas dpyad bzod du bden par grub pa'i chos de/ don dam bden pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ de'i dpyad bzod du bden pa ma grub pa'i chos de/ kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan nyid yin zhing / kun rdzob bden pa'i khyab mnyam dang dbye ba kun brtags dang 'dra'o/ /don dam bden pa'i khyab mnyam ni/ don dam bden pa dang kun brtags ma yin par gyur pa'i chos don gcig don dam bden pa de la/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na gzhan dbang dang yongs grub gnyis su yod cing / de la gzhi lam gyi sgo nas dbye na/ don dam bden pa/ sgrub pa don dam bden pa dang / thob pa don dam bden pa gsum yod cing /

dang po dang chos nyid don gcig gnyis pa dang lam don gcig gsum pa dang myang 'das don gcig ste/ dbus mtha' las/ don dam thob dang sgrub pa dang / don dam rnam pa gsum du 'dod ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa bdag med gnyis kyi rnam bzhag 'chad pa la bzhi ste/ rtogs bya bdag med ngos bzung ba dang / de rtogs pa'i lta ba ngos bzung ba/ de theg pa gsum dang sbyor tshul/ de grub mtha' dang sbyor tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gang zag gi bdag med dang chos kyi bdag med gnyis po de la 'jog gnyis pa lta ba ngos bzung ba la/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba dang / chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba gnyis/ dang po la yang kun brtags kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba dang / lhan skyes kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ngar 'dzin kun brtags kyi gzung byar gyur pa'i nga'am bdag rang bzhin gyis ma grub par rtogs pa'i lta ba de la 'jog gnyis pa ni/ ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi gzung byar gyur pa'i chos rang bzhin gyis ma grub par rtogs pa'i lta ba de la 'jog go /gnyis pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba de la/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba dang / 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni/ gzung bya phyi rol gyi don bden med du rtogs pa'i lta ba la 'jog gnyis pa ni/ phyi rol don snang kyi dbang shes la phyi rol don du snang ba bden med du rtogs pa'i lta ba lta bu la 'jog gsum pa theg pa gsum dang sbyor tshul ni/ kun brtags kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba de gtso bor nyan thos slob pa'i lta ba yin/ lhan skyes kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba de gtso bo nyan thos mi slob pa'i lta ba yin/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba de gtso bo rang rgyal gyi lta ba yin/

'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba de theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i lta ba yin/ bzhi pa de grub mtha' dang sbyor tshul ni/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba de sems tsam rnam bden rdzun gnyis kar gyi thun mong ba'i lta ba yin/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba de/ gtso bor sems tsam rnam bden pa'i lta ba yin/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba de/ sems tsam rnam rdzun pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lta ba yin te/ rigs gter rang 'grel las/ nyan thos kyi slob pas gang zag gi bdag med rtogs shing / mi slob pas ni lhan skyes kyi bdag med rtogs la/ rang sangs rgyas kyis ni chos kyi bdag gzung ba rang bzhin med pa phyed dang gnyis rtogs la/ byang chub sems pas bdag med gnyis ka rtogs shing / sangs rgyas kyis ni bag chags dang bcas pa'i sgrib pa spangs pa'i tshul gyis rtogs so zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa lam gyi rnam gzhag 'chad pa la/ bgrod byed kyi lam bshad pa/ mtshon pa rnal 'byor sa lnga bshad pa gnyis/ dang po nyan thos kyi lam lnga/ rang rgyal gyi lam lnga/ theg chen gyi lam lnga'o/ /dang po nyan thos kyi tshogs lam dang sbyor lam gang rung yin na/ gang zag gi bdag med don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pas khyab/ mthong sgom mi slob lam dang gsum po gang rung yin na/ de mngon sum du rtogs pas khyab la/ de yang nyan thos kyi mthong lam dang sgom lam gang rung yin na/ kun brtags kyi gang zag gi bdag med dngos su rtogs pas khyab/ de'i mi slob lam yin na lhan skyes kyi gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pas khyab bo/ /gnyis pa rang rgyal gyi lam lnga la yang / rang rgyal gyi tshogs sbyor gang rung yin na yang / gang zag gi bdag med dang gzung ba chos kyi bdag med gnyis don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pas khyab/ rang rgyal gyi mthong lam dang / sgom lam gang rung yin na/

kun btags kyi gang zag gi bdag med dang / gzung ba chos kyi bdag med gnyis ka mngon sum du rtogs pas khyab/ rang rgyal gyi mi slob lam yin na/ lhan skyes kyi gang zag gi bdag med dang / gzung ba chos kyi bdag med gnyis ka mngon sum du rtogs pas khyab bo/ /des na nyan thos kyi lam dang / rang rgyal gyi lam gang rung yin na/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs pas khyab pa yin no/ /gsum pa theg chen gyi lam la yang tshogs lam sogs lnga yod pa las/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam yin na/ gang zag gi bdag med dang / gzung ba chos kyi bdag med gnyis rtogs pas khyab/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam la/ drod snang ba thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ rtse mo snang ba mched pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ bzod pa gzung med rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ chos mchog bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang bzhi yod la/ de bzhi po gang rung yin na/ gang zag gzung ba 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med gsum ka rtogs pas khyab cing / theg chen gyi 'phags lam yin na/ bdag med de gsum mngon sum du rtogs pas khyab bo/ /gnyis pa rnal 'byor sa lnga zhes pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ tshogs kyi gzhi dang skyed yod na/ /ming tsam du ni mthong bar 'gyur/ /ming tsam mthong ste der mthong na/ /der yang phyis nas mi mthong ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi/ tshogs kyi gzhi dang / bskyed pa dang / me long lta bu dang / snang ba dang / rten dang lnga la rnal 'byor sa lnga zhes 'jog cing / mtshan gzhi yang rim bzhin/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam lta bu/ gnyis pa ni de dag gi sbyor lam drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa dang gsum po lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni de'i sbyor lam chos mchog lta bu/ bzhi pa ni de'i mthong lam dang sgom lam lta bu/ lnga pa ni theg chen gyi mi slob lam la 'jog pa yin no/ /gsum pa 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag la/ sangs rgyas kyi sku la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis las/

dang po ni/ spangs rtogs mthar thug pa'i sku de/ de'i mtshan nyid yin/ sku la dbye na/ chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku dang gsum yod cing / chos sku la dbye na yang / rtogs ye chos sku dang ngo bo nyid sku gnyis su yod do/ /de yang 'thad de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sku gsum dag gis sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku bsdus par ni shes bya ste/ /zhes sogs sems tsam rang gi rang gzhung rnams dag las bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na theg pa gsum gyi gang zag rnams la sems tsam rnam bden rdzun gnyis kyi skabs gzhir bzhag la khyab mtha' bzung / nyan thos lam zhugs kyi gang zag yin na mdo sde pa yin pas khyab/ rang rgyal yin na sems tsam rnam bden pa yin pas khyab/ theg chen gyi gang zag yin na sems tsam rnam rdzun pa yin pas khyab ces byas pas chog go /zhar byung gzugs sgra la sogs pa yod med la dpyad pa la/ kha cig na re/ gzugs sgra la sogs pa med de/ bem po med pa'i phyir zhes pa rang 'grel du/ 'dir shes bya la dngos po dang dngos med gnyis las ma 'das la/ dngos po bem rig gnyis las ma 'das/ bem po'i lugs gang 'dod kyang bkag zin la zhes bzhed/ rang lugs gzugs sgra la sogs pa yod de/ don rig mngon sum yod pa'i phyir te/ don rig smra ba rang rang gi /grub mtha'i stobs kyis tshad 'bras 'jog /ces pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir/ gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyis stong pa'i stong nyid de yul gyi gnas lugs mthar thug yin par thal/ de phyir gnyis stong gang yin pa zhes pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyis stong pa'i stong nyid yod par thal/ de yul gyi gnas lugs mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzung 'dzin gyi tshad ma rdzas gzhan gyis stong pa'i stong nyid yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod na/ gzung 'dzin tshad ma rdzas gzhan med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ yod par thal/
